I was at Sollich 4 Kitchen and stabilized the caramel flow through the Conbar. It is running very well now. The steam system is also working properly.

Regarding the cooking time, I suspect the operators are pausing the cooking process to avoid mixing two kettles in the reserve tank. This causes the caramel to burn on the kettle walls.

What we need to do is monitor the timing and make sure that when the reserve tank reaches 10%–15%, the cooking cycle finishes so the caramel can discharge into the reserve tank.

I calculated the timing previously, but I suspect the operators are not following that calculation.
